## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) for the practice of **Akṣobhya** 阿閦 (the Vajradhātu eastern Buddha — *Imperturbable*) — the principal deity of the eastern Vajra-family in the Vajradhātu mandala.

**Abstract**

The text gives the daily-practice manual for a practitioner whose *iṣṭa-devatā* is Akṣobhya — covering the *mudrā*-mantra-visualisation triplets for the central Akṣobhya practice, the offering sequences, and the *japa* of the Akṣobhya *mūla-mantra* and ancillary mantras. Akṣobhya is associated with the **mirror-wisdom** (*mahā-ādarśa-jñāna* / *dàyuánjìng zhì* 大圓鏡智) and the **eastern direction** in the Vajradhātu mandala; the practice removes karmic obstructions by purifying the *ādāna* (storehouse-consciousness).

The composition dates from Amoghavajra's mature Chángān period (746–774).
